subject: U-442 r3: 6 of 7 items closed; H-7 code half done, waivers pending
body: Landed all seven round-3 items on u-442 across five trailer-free commits (impl cd07307e, evidence 378a1a2e/5269310a, report 1ce683eb/e8ea772b) after merging BASE 81c8772a clean: H-3 restores the legacy 20s symbol-grep budget at the call site (no named constant — verify.py's WIDTH ratchet has two slots left and a timeout is not an interface), H-7 deletes the verify.py:209 pragma and covers the fail-closed OSError branch, H-1/H-5 pin BOTH the ordinary and escaping paths on the two symlink fixtures over otherwise-valid evidence, and H-4/H-6 add the one-flag collisions, same-repo nested borrow, and divergent HEAD/base symbol fixtures; H-2 re-emits the manifest at head cd07307e with four exit-0 evidence-run receipts whose wtree is exactly eff64964 (each ran in its own fresh worktree so the fingerprint is not polluted by the wrapper's own writes), all four criteria addressed, intent refreshed, NC re-derived at this head, and artifacts[] pinning the r2+r3 files. Suite 1733 green, validate exit 0, and 15 mutants all KILLED by assertion with zero survivors — round 2's nine replayed against the moved test surface (M8's anchor re-expressed, since H-3 changed the line it replaces) plus six round-3 mutants that kill N1 and/or N2 on the root classifier, N5 on pin-authorized escape, N4 on the base-vs-HEAD grep ref, N6 on the restored clock and N7 on fail-open.
